Reason: The chest X-ray shows a mass in the right breast (indicated by the arrow) and a distinct nodule in the right lung. Given that breast cancer commonly metastasizes to the lungs, this spatial relationship supports the likelihood of metastatic spread from the breast primary to the lung.
